title: Sindh Local Government Third Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Third Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2010
ACT VII OF 2010
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (THIRD AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV,
14th April, 2010]
No.PAS/Legis-B-4/2010,
dated 14-4-2010.---The Sindh Local Government (Third
Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th March, 2010 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 9th April, 2010 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Local
Government (Third Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

sections.description:
Amendment in section 179-A of Sindh Ordinance No.XXVII of 2001

ACT VII OF 2010
ACT VII OF 2010
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (THIRD AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV,
14th April, 2010]
No.PAS/Legis-B-4/2010,
dated 14-4-2010.---The Sindh Local Government (Third
Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th March, 2010 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 9th April, 2010 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment in
section 179-A of Sindh Ordinance No.XXVII
of 2001.---In the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
in section 179-A---
(i) in subsection (3), after the
words "Local Governments", the words "and Councils" shall
be added;
(ii) in subsection (5), for clauses (a) and (b), the following
shall be substituted:
(a) On dissolution
of the Local Governments and Councils, the Government shall, within seventy
five days, request the Chief Election Commissioner, for holding the
elections of the Local Governments;
(b) The elections of the Local Governments shall be
conducted under this amendment or new enactment. In case, any new law is not
passed, the elections shall be conducted under this amendment. In any case, the
Government shall ensure elections within 165 days within the scope of clause
(a) above.
